cues: Its ore is bright red cinnabar, mercury sulphide.
Extraction is the easiest in the syllabus.
Roast it in air at seven to eight hundred kelvin, and mercury comes straight off as vapour.
Even if mercury oxide forms first, it decomposes on heating, which is exactly how Priestley discovered oxygen.
So no reducing agent is needed.
